messages:
Zara (Design): quick drop 12 mini-mock for the latency chart: add keyboard-first scrubber, p95 mini-tooltip that sticks while you scrub, a granularity toggle (auto/1m/5m), and an optional patterned overlay for colorblind users. figma: https://figma.com/... :pushpin:
Hank (PM): this feels solid. product question: when do we auto-enable sampling? still >24h or >2M rows? can we surface that decision inline?
Eli (Frontend): lean toward >24h or >2M rows. tech note: scrubbing is noisy; propose pointer debounce=95ms, keyboard debounce=45ms, and client smoothing for live p95 = 2.2s. add an "Exact view" action that requests unsmoothed/raw data for debugging.
Aaron (SRE): agree. telemetry asks: emit `viz.sampling_auto`, `viz.granularity_change`, and `viz.p95_smoothing` so we can correlate missed spikes. also add a Grafana panel to track sampling frequency by org.
Lina (A11y): a11y checklist:
- scrubber must be a real slider (role="slider") with arrow/shift+arrow/pageup/pagedown. aria-valuetext should read: "From 09:00 to 10:00"
- when sampling toggles show aria-live=polite: "Sampling active: results may be approximate"
- patterned overlay toggle must have accessible label and keyboard focus and describe what pattern it applies
- p95 tooltip should be reachable by keyboard and announce "p95 245ms, sampled" when sampling is on
Zara (Design): for copy i propose: label = "Sample rate", tooltip = "Applied to long ranges to reduce query cost; values may be approximate." banner text = "Sampling applied 12 results may be approximate" (auto-dismiss 5s) and persistent mini-tag on p95.
Hank (PM): copy approved. show small banner + persistent tag. link the tooltip to docs for more detail.
Eli (Frontend): implementation plan: backend returns `meta.sampled=true` and `meta.granularity=...` with heatmap payload so client can toggle tag without extra calls. i'll wire debounce/smoothing and the Exact action. PR incoming.
Aaron (SRE): i'll add telemetry and the dashboard. please include reason in the telemetry (range/rowcount) so we can filter.
Lina (A11y): i'll validate with NVDA + VoiceOver and check focus order: presets -> granularity -> scrubber -> sampling control -> p95 tooltip.
figma-bot: created PR #5455: "latency-granularity-sampled-badge-a11y" and added reviewers @Eli @Lina :robot_face:
Zara (Design): thanks team 12 next steps: Eli implements, Lina reviews a11y, Aaron wires telemetry, Hank approves docs link text. i'll update figma after PR merges :sparkles:
